name: hachioji-gov
description: hachioji-gov: 八王子市の子育て・医療・福祉ナビ

scripts.test:integration: node scripts/capture-output.mjs logs/test-output.log npm run test:integration:raw
scripts.test:integration:raw: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-hachioji-gov "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
scripts.test:security: npm run test:integration && npm run test:log-scan
scripts.deploy:api: gcloud run deploy hachioji-gov-api --image=asia-northeast1-docker.pkg.dev/$(gcloud config get-value project)/hachioji-gov/api:latest --region=asia-northeast1 --set-env-vars=GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=$(gcloud config get-value project) --service-account=${SA_API:?SA_API を設定してください} --min-instances=0 --max-instances=3 --memory=512Mi --timeout=300 --allow-unauthenticated
scripts.deploy:collector: gcloud run jobs deploy hachioji-gov-collector --image=asia-northeast1-docker.pkg.dev/$(gcloud config get-value project)/hachioji-gov/collector:latest --region=asia-northeast1 --set-env-vars=GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=$(gcloud config get-value project) --service-account=${SA_COLLECTOR:?SA_COLLECTOR を設定してください} --memory=1Gi --task-timeout=900 --max-retries=1
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w @hachioji-gov/web && firebase deploy --only hosting
